parameters.description: Custom label for the conference resource, up to 64 characters.

parameters.description: Conferences created after the provided timestamp specified in ISO 8601 format

parameters.description: The unique SID identifier of the Conference.

parameters.name: ParticipantSid
parameters.description: The unique SID identifier of the Participant.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: User-specified label for a participant.

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: Conference events generated by application or participant activity; e.g. `hold`, `mute`, etc.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

parameters.name: PageToken
parameters.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

conference_sid.description: The unique SID identifier of the Conference.

account_sid.description: The unique SID identifier of the Account.

friendly_name.description: Custom label for the conference resource, up to 64 characters.

create_time.description: Conference creation date and time in ISO 8601 format.

start_time.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when the conference started. Conferences do not start until at least two participants join, at least one of whom has startConferenceOnEnter=true.

end_time.description: Conference end date and time in ISO 8601 format.

connect_duration_seconds.description: Duration of the between conference start event and conference end event in seconds.

status.description: Status of this Conference; `in_progress`, `not_started`, `completed` or `summary_timeout`. if Twilio don't receive `last_participant_left` event, summary will be timeout after 24 hours

max_participants.description: Maximum number of concurrent participants as specified by the configuration.

max_concurrent_participants.description: Actual maximum number of concurrent participants in the conference.

unique_participants.description: Unique conference participants based on caller ID.

end_reason.description: Conference end reason; e.g. last participant left, modified by API, etc.

ended_by.description: Call SID of the participant whose actions ended the conference.

mixer_region.description: Twilio region where the conference media was mixed.

mixer_region_requested.description: Twilio region where conference mixed was specified to be mixed in configuration.

recording_enabled.description: Boolean. Indicates whether recording was enabled at the conference mixer.

detected_issues.description: Potential issues detected by Twilio during the conference.

tags.description: Tags for detected conference conditions and participant behaviors which may be of interest.

tag_info.description: Object. Contains details about conference tags including severity.

processing_state.description: Processing state for the Conference Summary resource. Will be `in_progress` while data is being aggregated, `timeout` if Twilio couldn't process the summary in 24hrs, and `complete` once aggregations and analysis has ended.

links.description: Contains a dictionary of URL links to nested resources of this Conference.

label.description: The user-specified label of this participant.

conference_sid.description: The unique SID identifier of the Conference.

call_sid.description: Unique SID identifier of the call that generated the Participant resource.

account_sid.description: The unique SID identifier of the Account.

call_direction.description: Call direction of the participant; inbound or outbound.

from.description: Caller ID of the calling party.

call_status.description: Call status of the call that generated the participant.

country_code.description: ISO alpha-2 country code of the participant based on caller ID or called number.

is_moderator.description: Boolean. Indicates whether participant had startConferenceOnEnter=true or endConferenceOnExit=true.

join_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of participant join event.

leave_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of participant leave event.

outbound_queue_length.description: Add Participant API only. Estimated time in queue at call creation.

outbound_time_in_queue.description: Add Participant API only. Actual time in queue in seconds.

jitter_buffer_size.description: The Jitter Buffer Size of this Conference Participant. One of `large`, `small`, `medium` or `off`.

is_coach.description: Boolean. Indicated whether participant was a coach.

coached_participants.description: Call SIDs coached by this participant.

participant_region.description: Twilio region where the participant media originates.

conference_region.description: The Conference Region of this Conference Participant. One of `us1`, `us2`, `au1`, `br1`, `ie1`, `jp1`, `sg1` or `de1`.

call_type.description: The Call Type of this Conference Participant. One of `carrier`, `client` or `sip`.

processing_state.description: Processing state of the Participant Summary. Will be `in_progress` while data is being aggregated, `timeout` if Twilio couldn't process the summary in 24hrs, and `complete` once aggregations and analysis has ended.

events.description: Object containing information of actions taken by participants. Contains a dictionary of URL links to nested resources of this Conference Participant.

metrics.description: Object. Contains participant call quality metrics.
